summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K attaching a letter to the Chilean Financial Market Commission (CMF) reporting the local-market placement of senior dematerialized bearer bonds. The bonds, Series FG under registry No. 11/2022, total CLF 300,000 (approx. $11.5M) with a 2.80% average rate maturing November 1, 2030. This is a routine debt issuance. No special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change—just an ordinary capital markets activity. (This 6-K corresponds to a U.S. equivalent of a debt-takedown notice; no risk-arb angle.)
